non_blocking_findings.fact: Three pipeline tooling defects are disclosed and deliberately deferred by the owner: (a) build.ps1 does not relink on a .pro-only change; (b) artifacts.ps1 globs leftover build/build-* exes and can deploy a stale/foreign binary; (c) artifacts.ps1 copies source-side DLLs over dist and can poison the Qt runtime.
non_blocking_findings.hypothesis: They can produce a non-reproducible GREEN on another machine.
non_blocking_findings.evidence: observed live during this branch: run-20261011-05 had all 14 suites fail after artifacts.ps1 deployed a 2026-10-01 diag binary and 2018-era Qt DLLs; preserved, not overwritten
non_blocking_findings.business_impact: A future GREEN may not correspond to the candidate under test.
non_blocking_findings.suggested_fix: Repair the three defects, or have test.ps1 assert the deployed binary is not older than the candidate build.
non_blocking_findings.residual_risk: Non-reproducible gate result if triggered again.
